sources.citation: de Clercq, F. S. A. 1894. The Western and Northern Coasts of Netherlands New Guinea. In Geo. G. Batten (ed.), Glimpses of the Eastern Archipelago: Ethnographical, Geographical, Historical, 1-29. Singapore: Singapore and Straits Printing Office. (English translation of de Clercq 1893, TKNAG 2e ser. 10.)
sources.note: No phonology content: ethnographic-geographic overview (villages, house types, ornaments, one plant name 'cit' coconut at Takar) and the remark that 'the Papuans of Takar can only count up to two' with the numeral list; only language remarks concern dialect sameness on the Koemamba islands and Podena/Anoes (Austronesian neighbours).

sources.citation: Badan Pengembangan dan Pembinaan Bahasa (Kemendikdasmen). n.d. Peta Bahasa - Bahasa Betaf-Takar (Fitoow Or), Provinsi Papua. Online language-mapping entry (idb=323).
sources.source_kind: database or survey citing another work
sources.note: No phonology content: location (Kampung Betaf, Distrik Pantai Timur; Finyabor (Takar), Distrik Pantai Timur Bagian Barat, Kab. Sarmi), two dialects Betaf vs Takar with 76.48% lexical difference, 94.5-100% difference from Anus, Berik, Dabe, Beneraf (dialectometry).
